column1: # Method batch: ai.intent.IntentGroup (21 methods, was 100% obfuscated).
# The class is the AI's unit "squad": a set of requested unit types (UnitRequestList b) plus the
# units actually assigned to it (UnitList c), with a target (UnitPosition f + flag g) and a mode.
#  * getters/setters are paired on the same field, and the static factory a() shows the initial
#    value of every field (empty request list, empty unit list, flag false, mode a, empty position).
#  * behaviour comes from the bodies: b() returns the assigned unit with the highest
#    UnitType.getSortWeight(); c() walks Domain[]{Water, Air, Ground, Amphibian} in that order and
#    returns the first one present among the assigned units or the requests; d() returns the
#    position of the first unit/request of that domain; g() delegates to UnitList.b(), which is
#  * the target pair: j()/k() return the position / the unit only when the flag g is set, and
#    a(float,float) / a(Unit) are the only writers that set it, so they are the target setters.
#  * m() (field d) is set true only in MoveToTargetPlan L183, right after the target position was
#    resolved and the mode was switched to b - i.e. "this group has been ordered to move" - and it
#    is cleared again by the Monitor* plans once the group engages a unit instead of travelling.
#    AdvanceToTargetNode then reads it to choose between following the lead unit and heading
# Descriptors come from javap: do not edit them, the renamer matches on them.
